title: subscribe_events accepts unexpanded URI template; no helper to expand it
description: Session.event_source_url is a URI Template (RFC 6570 Level 1) with variables types, closeafter, and ping. subscribe_events(event_source_url, last_event_id) accepts the raw string and passes it to reqwest. A caller who writes client.subscribe_events(&session.event_source_url, None) will send a literal {types} in the URL path, which the server will 404 or 400. The error surfaces as ClientError::Http, giving no hint that URL expansion is required. The expand_url_template helper exists in blob.rs but is pub(crate) — callers cannot use it. Callers must either do string replacement manually or use an external template library; neither is documented. Fix: either make expand_url_template pub, or add a expand_event_source_url helper, or document prominently in subscribe_events that the caller must expand the template first.
